hypothesis: The target contains 288 Q8_0 matrices totaling 6,734,479,360 weights, and their Q8_0 x Q8_0 kernel consumes 23.99% of MTP3 cycles. Selectively transcoding only those matrices to Q4_K halves their packed payload and routes them through the already optimized fused Q4_K CPU path. This aggressive PTQ artifact is a speed-and-quality ceiling screen; if performance passes but quality fails, QAT, residual correction, or sensitivity-selected Q5/Q8 retention is mandatory.

artifact_contract.transcoder_mode: COPY plus --allow-requantize and manual regex override

recovery_if_quality_fails: rank families and layers by paired logit/KL sensitivity on frozen calibration tokens
restore sensitive families to Q5_K or Q8_0 while keeping the measured speed gate
train per-channel scales plus low-rank residuals or QAT on the selected Q8 families
re-run every capability denominator; PTQ failure is not a zero and is not promotable
stop_rules: Reject an invalid artifact before generation.
Reject catastrophic free-generation collapse before timing.
Reject before long quality runs if graph speedup is below eight percent.
Reject promotion if any CUTE, WikiText, MMLU, or paired MATH gate fails.
Do not retain more than one derived full-model candidate on the 225 GB node.
claim_boundary: This experiment can establish whether replacing the Q8 hotspot with the optimized Q4 path has material system ceiling. PTQ alone cannot establish near-lossless quality, scientific novelty, a trained approximation, final-node behavior, energy gains, 100 accepted tok/s, or a breakthrough.
